title: TrackScout photos document
description: Served at GET /data/owner_photos.json: one record per stored photo, keyed by photo_id. The server returns 404 while there are no photos. Each JPEG is stored on the server under `stored` (a data-folder-relative path like photos/<capture-date>/<photo_id>.jpg) and fetchable at GET /photo/<url-encoded stored>. The photo's capture position is in the upload meta, not in this list document.

photo_id.description: Client-generated UUID; the idempotency key. Re-uploading the same id stores nothing new.

question_id.description: The question the photo was taken for; `null` for capture-mode photos (owner took a photo without a question). Null here means the project's agents should attach or discard it by judgement, never invent a question for it.

place_key.description: The place as a `lat,lon` string, or `null` for a capture that had no place.

kind.description: What the photo shows (the app's capture-mode selector). `storefront`/`facade` shots taken straight-on are the ones agents use to measure bays.

light.description: The light condition, auto-classified from the sun position at `taken` (the owner can override it).

taken.description: Capture time, ISO 8601 with the local UTC offset (e.g. 2026-10-30T21:14:05+01:00). For imports this is the photo's EXIF time.

stored.description: Where the JPEG lives on the server, relative to its data folder; fetch it at GET /photo/<url-encoded stored>.
